_readme: Offline play: put the line offline=offline.json (no spaces) in ap_config.ini instead of host/slotname and copy this file
to offline.json. seed/team/player pick the save folder: saves/ap_<seed>_<team>_<player>. Use an AP
save's folder to play it offline, or anything new for a fresh town. Names max 8 characters.
Numbers match the apworld options: skip_intro 0 off, 2 train and job. gender 0 boy, 1 girl.
face 0-7. starting_shirt 0-15, 16 = game's pick. house 0-3 (top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right).
town_fruit 0 apple, 1 cherry, 2 pear, 3 peach, 4 orange. grass_shape 0 triangle, 1 square, 2 circle.
train_station 0-14, -1 = game's pick. town_day 1-31 (not 4), 0 = game's pick. Toggles: 0 off, 1 on.
loans (Bells): starting, medium, basement, large, upper. The values below are vanilla.
critter_spawns (bugs, fish) 0 vanilla, 1 normalized, 2 dynamic (missing from journal or museum more likely).
fossil_spawns 0 vanilla, 1 dynamic (missing from museum more likely), 2 season locked (Spring Mar-May, ...).
New town settings only apply when the town is made.
